witnesses.separates: Three lone cells of color 2 sit far apart, and a 5 lands on the row between two of them with the third above it. Read as color classes, those three cells are one container and the 5 is inside it, so ColorClass erases the 5. Read as shapes, each 2 is its own one-cell shape, no shape has cells on two sides of the 5, and Shape keeps the whole grid.

A ring of color 2 is broken into a top-left arc and a bottom-right arc, with a 5 at its center. The two arcs are not eight-connected, so no single shape has the 5 between its cells and Shape keeps the 5. The color class holds both arcs, so ColorClass erases the 5.
